newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares surge, telecoms dominate.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares surge, telecoms dominate.

text.p: 1803 GMT - Portuguese shares ended higher with telecommunications dominating activity. Portugal Telecom and mobile phone operator Telecel together accounted for 55 percent of the 14.4 billion escudos turnover amid euphoria over the telecommunications sector. Dealers said a report by SBC Warburg setting a target porice of 7,000 escudos for Portugal Telecom helped the stock soar to a new high of 6,100 escudos at the close. Telecel hit a high of 13,900 escudos amid optimism over its 1996 results due to be announced on February 12, dealers said.
* Banco Espirito Santo hit a high of 3,206 escudos as the market was pleased with the strong rise in its 1996 profit and was optimistic about the bank's future performance, dealers said.
* Dealers said that tomorrow's session could be marked by profit taking after the surge today. "After the corrections, a new round of buying could start all over again," said one operator.
